documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Rolex Rings Limited reported its financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, achieving revenue from operations of Rs. 389 crore in Q2 FY27, supported by strong growth in automotive components. The company's order book averaged Rs. 120 crore to Rs. 125 crore per month as customer ordering resumed with confidence.

guidance.claim: Management expects performance in H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate revenues from the defence and aerospace segment within the next 12 months following initial approvals.
guidance.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident in achieving mid-teen revenue growth guidance for fiscal 2027.
guidance.quote: Both this thing taken together, we remain confident in the mid-teen revenue growth guidance that we have given for fiscal '27.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth to come close to 20% for fiscal 2028.
guidance.quote: On the revenue part, as I have indicated, mid-teen; we are a bit confident till now for fiscal '27 and maybe more than mid-teen or coming close to the 20% number for fiscal '28.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margin is conservatively expected to stay between 21% and 22% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

guidance.claim: Auto component exports are expected to reach between INR 425 crores and INR 450 crores in FY27.
guidance.quote: Not INR500 crores, but I'm a bit confident to cross between INR425 crores to INR450 crores.

guidance.claim: Management issued mid-teen growth guidance for the rest of FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, with the labour situation normalized, US re-engaging, and Europe continuing to build on our expanding automotive presence there, we head into the rest of FY27 with confidence with a mid-teen growth guidance and in our ambition to be the most trusted precision forging partner for the world's leading bearing and automotive OEMs

demand_outlook.claim: Customers who previously held back during FY26 have resumed placing orders with confidence, and newly won programs are scaling up.
demand_outlook.quote: Customers who held back through FY26 are placing orders with confidence again, and the new programmes we won last year are now scaling up.

demand_outlook.claim: US tariffs did not impact operations, and Q2 US automotive revenues grew over 100% year-on-year without any loss of customers.
demand_outlook.quote: US tariffs have not impacted our business. Our US automotive revenues more than doubled year-on-year in Q2. Our relationships with US customers have stayed intact, and we have not lost a single customer to tariffs.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is expanding its automotive presence in Europe and is discussing opportunities with a large OEM for commercial vehicle and industrial products.
demand_outlook.quote: In Europe, we continue to build on our expanding automotive presence and are in discussions with a large OEM for commercial vehicle and industrial products.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue from operations in Q1 FY27 rose by 4.3% year-on-year to INR 304 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to Q1 FY27, we'd like to inform you that revenue from operations recorded came in at INR 304 crores, which is up by 4.3% precisely compared to Q1 FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Overseas customers are re-engaging and placing orders again with confidence.
demand_outlook.quote: Buyers who had been a bit cautious and holding back through in fiscal '26, with a wait-and-watch mode as tariff uncertainty and certain adverse market factors played out, are now placing orders again with confidence.

demand_outlook.claim: Rolex Rings recorded its highest monthly revenue since inception in July 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: I would like to inform or pleased to inform that in month July '26, we recorded the highest revenue since the inception of our operations.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed a shift in customer behaviour with buyers placing orders again with confidence after holding back in FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: What stands out most is a change in customer behaviour - buyers who had been cautious and holding back through FY26 are now placing orders again with confidence.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that overseas demand is picking up.
demand_outlook.quote: This shift matters because it tells us that demand overseas is genuinely picking up.

demand_outlook.claim: Business has not been affected by US tariffs and is returning to normalcy.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the US imposing tariffs, business has not been affected and is coming back to normalcy.

capex_expansion.claim: Rolex Rings is setting up an additional 9MW solar plant targeted for completion by Mid-CY2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

capex_expansion.claim: Annual capex spend is targeted in the range of INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In the range of INR30 crores to INR40 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is exploring a joint venture or association with an overseas player to establish manufacturing operations in India.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also looking for inorganic growth or maybe some association or some JV with an overseas player to be based in India, wherein the base of the utilization of Rolex facilities will increase and more value-added processes where the third party has some expertise and a ready market available.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 Gross Margin expanded to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with margins at 24.2%, and PAT reached Rs. 74 crore including a one-time customs refund.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by 220 bps to 55%, EBITDA grew 72% to Rs. 94 crore with margins at 24.2%, and PAT grew 68% to Rs. 74 crore considering one time receipt.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 increased 12% year-on-year to INR 69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 22.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR69 crores. I'm not considering other income, which is up by 12% on comparing with the Q1 FY26, with the EBITDA margin at a percentage of 22.6%, which is up by 100 basis points, again, on comparing with Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue grew by 4% to Rs. 304 crores alongside improvements in gross margins and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue grew by 4% to Rs. 304 crores with Gross Margins & profitability improving.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's order book averages between Rs. 120 crore and Rs. 125 crore per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book continues to remain strong, averaging in the range of Rs.120 crores to Rs 125 crores per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Full normalization of the labor situation from the start of Q2 enabled order book conversion into output at the planned pace.
orders_capacity.quote: With the labour situation fully normalised from the start of the quarter, we were able to convert this order book into output at the pace we had planned.

orders_capacity.claim: Supplies to one to two new customer plants will commence in Q3 while capacity utilization stands at 63-65%.
orders_capacity.quote: One to two new customer plants begin supplies in Q3, new programmes continue to ramp up, and our capacity utilisation of 63-65% gives us ample room to grow.

orders_capacity.claim: Plant capacity utilization currently stands between 63% and 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: We are at the same 63% to 65% utilization, you can say.

orders_capacity.claim: Management targets capacity utilization to reach 70% to 72% during the fiscal year.
orders_capacity.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

orders_capacity.claim: A temporary shop floor labor shortage restricted conversion of the healthy order book into production output during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: A shortage of labor on the shop floor meant we could not convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted to.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintained a healthy order book throughout the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stayed healthy through the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings maintains a debt-free balance sheet following the completion of its Rs. 180 crore share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: With a debt-free balance sheet, the Rs. 180 crore buyback completed, and a strong pipeline across Europe, the US and India, we head into H2 FY27 with confidence.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a share buyback of 1 crore equity shares amounting to INR 180 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Would like to inform you that our INR180 crores buyback of 1 crores equity shares concluded during the quarter, with the promoter group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed directly to non-promoter shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Rolex Rings is fully debt-free and has cleared all legacy CDR obligations.
capital_allocation.quote: As of today, we are fully debt-free and clear of all legacy CDR obligations.

capital_allocation.claim: A buyback of Rs. 180 crore was completed in the quarter without promoter participation.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 180 crore buyback got concluded during the quarter, with the Promoter Group choosing not to participate so that the full benefit flowed to our public shareholders.

risks_headwinds.claim: Softness in the industrial bearing ring segment was concentrated in domestic and European markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: The bearing rings softness was concentrated in the industrial business or in the industrial segment, particularly in the domestic and European market, an area where we have flagged our broader industry-wide stagnancy in the past, and it reflects the same labor-driven output constraint that affected quarter too.

risks_headwinds.claim: Container availability at a reasonable cost remains a persistent constraint for exports.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, availability of containers at a proper cost is an issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations were constrained by labour availability on the shop floor rather than demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: The constraint was labour availability, not demand.

risks_headwinds.claim: A shortage of workers prevented output conversion at the desired pace.
risks_headwinds.quote: A shortage of workers on the shop floor meant we couldn't convert that order book into output at the pace we wanted.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects performance in H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects revenues from defence and aerospace over the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: We have received registrations and initial approvals in defence and aerospace and expect revenues from this segment over the next 12 months.

management_commitments.claim: Rolex Rings plans to set up an additional 9MW solar plant by mid-CY2026.
management_commitments.quote: Additional 9MW solar plant to be setup by Mid - CY2026

management_commitments.claim: Management conservatively expects EBITDA margin to remain between 21% and 22% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect -- let me tell you conservatively, we expect that to be in the range of 21% to 22% in this fiscal FY27 conservatively.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets capacity utilization levels of 70% to 72% during the current fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: We target to touch somewhere about 70%-72%

management_commitments.claim: Management expects auto component exports to cross between INR 425 crores and INR 450 crores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Not INR500 crores, but I'm a bit confident to cross between INR425 crores to INR450 crores.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
